# Plooshi

> Plooshi is a children's music brand (artist name on Spotify and YouTube) making sing-along songs, nursery rhymes and lullabies for toddlers and preschoolers (about ages 1–6), plus 96 free printable coloring pages, kid-safe learning games and fun-fact articles. Everything on plooshi.com is free, with no sign-up.

Plooshi is based in Austin, Texas (founded 2023). Contact: info@plooshi.com. Links: [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@plooshimusic), [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/artist/7im2jVMioz2l4PWG37YbFV), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/plooshimusic/).

## Coloring pages
- [All 96 free printable coloring pages](https://plooshi.com/printable/): each has a print-ready PDF at /printable/<name>/
- [Color online](https://plooshi.com/color/): color any page in the browser with tap-to-fill
- Food: Ice Cream Cone, Food, Strawberry, Gingerbread Man, Watermelon, Pizza, Birthday Cake, Cake, Apple, Donut, Gingerbread House
- Animals: Spider, Wolf, Shark, Hamster, Lion, Kitten, Owl, Jellyfish, Cow, Tiger, Alligator, Eagle, Llama, Teddy Bear, Squirrel, Fox, Koala, Bee, Sea Turtle, Chicken, Turkey, Ladybug, Dog, Fish, Horse, Reindeer, Cheetah, Octopus, Bird, Cat, Snake, Kitty, Butterfly, Bunny, Puppy
- Nature: Phone, Family, Sun, Heart, Leaf, Ocean, Snowflake, Flower, Rainbow
- Fantasy: Astronaut, Alien, Pirate, Ninja, Castle, Mermaid, Dragon, Princess, Unicorn
- Holidays: Skeleton, Candy Cane, Cross, American Flag, Gingerbread Man, Pumpkin, Halloween, Turkey, Reindeer, Easter, Elf, Leprechaun, Christmas, Snowman, Christmas Tree, Santa, Gingerbread House
- Dinosaurs: Triceratops, Dino, Dinosaur, Dragon, T-Rex
- Vehicles: Excavator, Police Car, Dirt Bike, Tractor, Monster Truck, Airplane, Truck, Race Car, Train, Fire Truck, Car
- Sports: Soccer, Baseball, Football, Basketball

## Games
- [Color Online](https://plooshi.com/color/): Color any of our coloring pages right on the screen.
- [Dress Up Plooshi](https://plooshi.com/play/#dressup): Hats, glasses and bows — Plooshi wears them everywhere!
- [Freeze Dance](https://plooshi.com/play/#freeze): Dance to the beat, then FREEZE when the music stops!
- [Animal Quiz](https://plooshi.com/play/#quiz): Can you find the lion? Learn a fun fact each time.
- [Memory Match](https://plooshi.com/play/#memory-panel): Flip the cards and find the animal pairs.
- [Bubble Count](https://plooshi.com/play/#bubbles-panel): Pop the bubbles in order and learn to count!
- [Xylophone](https://plooshi.com/play/#xylophone): Play Twinkle Twinkle and other songs.
- [Color Plooshi](https://plooshi.com/play/#color): Pick colors and paint Plooshi any way you like.
